description: This file contains unit tests for the StringUtils utility class within the com.karankumar.bookproject.util package. It verifies the behavior of the pluralize method, checking singular and plural cases.

classes.name: StringUtilsTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the StringUtils utility class, specifically the pluralize method.

methods.name: returnSingularStringOnPluralize
methods.description: Tests that the pluralize method returns a singular form when the count is 1.

methods.name: returnPluralStringOnPluralize
methods.description: Tests that the pluralize method returns a plural form when the count is greater than 1.
